={
  "code": "import subprocess, json

# -------- CONFIG --------
#video_url = '{{ $('Code in JavaScript').first().json.s3_url }}/{{ $('Code in JavaScript').first().json.bucket_name }}/{{ $json.filePath }}'
audio_url = '{{ $json.audioFilePath }}'

# -------- STEP 1: Get durations via ffprobe --------
def get_duration(url):
    try:
        cmd = [
            'ffprobe', '-v', 'error',
            '-show_entries', 'format=duration',
            '-of', 'default=nk=1:nw=1',
            url
        ]
        result = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
        return float(result.stdout.strip())
    except Exception as e:
        print('⚠️ ffprobe error:', e)
        return 0

#video_duration = get_duration(video_url)
audio_duration = get_duration(audio_url)
fade_start = max(audio_duration - 1, 0)
fade_start_str = f'{fade_start:.2f}'

print(json.dumps({'audio_duration': audio_duration, 'fade_start': fade_start_str}, indent=2))",
  "timeout": 300
}
